purpose: Close the eleven initially unsuccessful source retrieval checks without modifying the publication of record or its reference wording.
scope_and_limits: This is source identity, metadata and live access verification, not a rereview of the eleven works or certification of the citing paper’s scientific claims.
All inspected source material was original English; no translation or second-hand scholarly reconstruction was used.

Two Anthropic redirects yielded HTTP 200 after following redirects. Nine other URLs still refused command-line requests, but their intended publisher pages rendered in the browser. No CAPTCHA, paywall or browser security warning was bypassed.
The Wiley checks inspected metadata and abstracts, not full article bodies. Other checks inspected headings, bylines, date/version metadata and opening material, with relevant byline/footer blocks.
Parallel extraction acquisition dates are retained as reported; older extraction responses are corroboration, not live-freshness proof.
The original 76/11 acquisition result remains historical evidence. It is not replaced with a claim that all 87 original URLs now return HTTP 200.

Published reference strings and URLs, source blocks, text-edition prose, figures and original PDF are unchanged. Normalized bibliography fields and verification/provenance records are repository additions.
